This supports a limited regional inclusion reading, though it is still mostly rhetoric and election management.","question_ids":["5B.8"]},{"title":"Govt backs campaign to end violence against women","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office","date":"2024-12-02","url":"https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/govt-backs-campaign-to-end-violence-against-women/","summary":"The administration backed a national anti-violence campaign framed around women’s rights and protection, which is positive evidence for gender-targeted distribution.","question_ids":["5B.8"]},{"title":"DSWD touts govt efforts to end violence, abuse against women, children","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office","date":"2024-12-11","url":"https://mirror.pco.gov.ph/news_releases/dswd-touts-govt-efforts-to-end-violence-abuse-against-women-children/","summary":"Stronger referral, legal, medical, and shelter support for women and child survivors indicates concrete protection-oriented service delivery, though not full structural equality.","question_ids":["5B.8"]},{"title":"Marcos bans POGO, cites disorder it caused","publisher":"GMA News Online","date":"2024-07-22","url":"https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/914272/marcos-announces-ban-on-all-pogo/story/","summary":"Marcos framed the POGO ban as stopping torture, kidnapping, trafficking, and murder. This is evidence against privileging a politically connected, abusive sector over ordinary people.","question_ids":["5B.8","5B.5"]},{"title":"Marcos orders total ban on POGOs","publisher":"Philippine Daily Inquirer","date":"2024-07-23","url":"https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1964063/marcos-bans-pogo-cites-disorder-it-caused-ph","summary":"The ban directly targeted a sector associated with criminal exploitation, which helped vulnerable workers and migrants rather than elite insiders.","question_ids":["5B.8","5B.5"]},{"title":"U.S. Department of State report via ecoi.net","publisher":"U.S. Department of State","date":"2024","url":"https://www.ecoi.net/en/document/2128580.html","summary":"The report says the Marcos administration shifted drug policy toward treatment, due process, and rule-of-law investigations. This is strong negative evidence against fair distribution across groups.","question_ids":["5B.8","5B.5"]},{"title":"Red-tagging under Marcos puts activists at risk","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-01-11","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/philippines-red-tagging-puts-activists-risk","summary":"HRW says officials and supporters accused critics of insurgent ties, putting leftist activists at serious risk. That undercuts the claim that gains were spread fairly across political groups.","question_ids":["5B.8","5B.5"]},{"title":"Philippines report","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/philippines/freedom-world/2024","summary":"Freedom House says women’s representation is concentrated in political families, Muslims and Indigenous groups are underrepresented, and no national SOGI/SOGIESC anti-discrimination law exists. It also says red-tagging persisted. This is broad negative evidence on group fairness.","question_ids":["5B.8","5B.5"]},{"title":"Philippines report","publisher":"Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism","date":"2024-06-17","url":"https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/philippines","summary":"The report notes a media JV tied to Prime Media Holdings and the Romualdez family, suggesting politically connected business networks still mattered under Marcos. This is indirect but relevant evidence against fully even-handed distribution.","question_ids":["5B.8","5B.5"]}]}
